name: Veronika Novotná
bio:
Veronika's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, through a university project focused on analyzing the marketing strategies of various racing teams. Intrigued by the intricate interplay of branding, sponsorship, and fan engagement, she quickly became captivated by the world of Formula 1. After graduating with a degree in Marketing and Communications, Veronika interned with a smaller racing team, gaining invaluable experience in digital marketing, event planning, and sponsorship activation.

At Racing Bulls, Veronika brings a methodical and data-driven approach to her work. She thrives on understanding the nuances of the motorsport audience and crafting targeted campaigns that resonate with fans. Her innovation skills allow her to bring new ideas to the table to increase viewership and fanbase.

Veronika is known for her ability to translate complex technical information into compelling narratives that capture the essence of the team's performance and technological advancements. Her pragmatic nature keeps her grounded, ensuring that all marketing efforts are aligned with the team's overall strategic objectives.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, often pulled back into a practical ponytail during race weekends.
physical.description: Veronika has a slender build and a focused, intelligent gaze.

quirks: Always carries a notebook filled with marketing ideas and observations.
Has a peculiar habit of organizing her desk by color.
Often seen sketching logo ideas on napkins during lunch.
